introduction_en: Considered the Will of Earth, once allowed humans to live in harmony with nature. But after humans turned away from nature, Orochi became a symbol of evil.

name: Aizen Hogyiku
introduction_th: เคยเป็นหัวหน้าทีมที่ 5 ของโกเทย์ 13 แต่ทรยศโซลโซไซตี้ หนีไปฮูเอโก มุนโด และกลายเป็นผู้ปกครองที่นั่น ในการโจมตีโซลโซไซตี้ ถูกคุโรซากิ อิจิโกะ เอาชนะและถูกอุราฮาระ คิสึเกะ ผนึก ถูกตัดสินจำคุก 20,000 ปีและถูกขังที่ชั้นลึกสุดของนรกมูเคน ภายใต้หน่วยที่ 1 ด้วยรูปลักษณ์หล่อเหลานอกใจอ่อนโยน แต่จริง ๆ แล้วเป็นคนเย็นชาและทะเยอทะยาน
introduction: Former captain of the 5th Division of Gotei 13, later betrayed Soul Society, fled to Hueco Mundo, and became its ruler. During the Soul Society invasion, he was defeated by Kurosaki Ichigo and sealed by Urahara Kisuke. He was sentenced to 20,000 years in prison and locked in the deepest layer of Hell, Muken, under the 1st Division. With a handsome appearance and a gentle exterior, but in reality, a cold-hearted and ambitious person.
introduction_vn: Nguyên là đội trưởng đội 5 của Gotei 13, sau đó phản bội Soul Society, trốn đến Hueco Mundo và trở thành kẻ thống trị nơi này. Trong cuộc tấn công Soul Society, hắn bị Kurosaki Ichigo đánh bại và bị Urahara Kisuke phong ấn. Hắn bị kết án 20.000 năm tù và bị giam giữ tại tầng sâu nhất của Địa Ngục Muken dưới đội 1. Với ngoại hình điển trai, bên ngoài dịu dàng nhưng thực chất là một kẻ lạnh lùng và đầy tham vọng.
introduction_in: Dulunya kapten divisi 5 Gotei 13, kemudian mengkhianati Soul Society, melarikan diri ke Hueco Mundo dan menjadi penguasa di sana. Dalam serangan ke Soul Society, dia dikalahkan oleh Kurosaki Ichigo dan disegel oleh Urahara Kisuke. Dia dijatuhi hukuman penjara 20.000 tahun dan dipenjara di kedalaman Neraka Muken di bawah divisi 1. Dengan penampilan tampan, tampak lembut tetapi sebenarnya adalah sosok yang dingin dan penuh ambisi.
introduction_en: Former captain of the 5th Division of Gotei 13, later betrayed Soul Society, fled to Hueco Mundo, and became its ruler. During the Soul Society invasion, he was defeated by Kurosaki Ichigo and sealed by Urahara Kisuke. He was sentenced to 20,000 years in prison and locked in the deepest layer of Hell, Muken, under the 1st Division. With a handsome appearance and a gentle exterior, but in reality, a cold-hearted and ambitious person.

Sa kanyang kaakit-akit na hitsura, tila mabait ngunit sa katotohanan, siya ay isang malamig at ambisyosong tao.

Dalam serangan ke Soul Society, dia dikalahkan oleh Kurosaki Ichigo dan disegel oleh Urahara Kisuke. Dia dijatuhi hukuman penjara 20,000 tahun dan dipenjarakan di lapisan terdalam Neraka Muken di bawah pasukan 1. Dengan penampilan yang kacak, di luar lembut tetapi sebenarnya adalah seorang yang dingin dan penuh cita-cita.

name: Akaza
introduction_th: Agatsuma Zenitsu เป็นนักดาบพิฆาตอสูรและสมาชิกของหน่วยพิฆาตอสูร เขาเป็นเพื่อนร่วมทางของ Kamado Tanjiro และเป็นหนึ่งในตัวละครหลักของ Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
introduction: In a life-or-death battle at the boundary between life and death, Akaza awakened the dormant potential in his bloodline. A surge of intense hatred combined with ancient spiritual power allowed him to evolve beyond limits — each punch now carries soul-shattering aftershocks, disintegrating enemies on contact. His martial arts are not just physical strength, but a deadly symphony of Blood Demon Art and immortal pride!
introduction_vn: Trong một trận chiến sinh tử nơi ranh giới âm dương, Akaza đã đánh thức tiềm lực ngủ quên trong huyết mạch. Luồng hận thù mãnh liệt kết hợp với linh lực cổ xưa giúp hắn tiến hóa vượt bậc — mỗi cú đấm giờ đây mang theo dư chấn phá hủy linh hồn, khiến kẻ địch vừa chạm đã tan rã. Võ thuật của hắn không chỉ là sức mạnh cơ bắp, mà là bản giao hưởng chết chóc của huyết quỷ thuật và lòng kiêu hãnh bất diệt!
introduction_in: Dalam pertarungan hidup dan mati di batas antara kehidupan dan kematian, Akaza membangkitkan potensi yang tertidur dalam garis keturunannya. Gelombang kebencian yang hebat dipadukan dengan kekuatan spiritual kuno memungkinkannya berevolusi melampaui batas — setiap pukulan kini membawa getaran yang menghancurkan jiwa, membuat musuh hancur seketika. Seni bela dirinya bukan hanya kekuatan fisik, tetapi simfoni mematikan dari Blood Demon Art dan kebanggaan abadi!
introduction_en: In a life-or-death battle at the boundary between life and death, Akaza awakened the dormant potential in his bloodline. A surge of intense hatred combined with ancient spiritual power allowed him to evolve beyond limits — each punch now carries soul-shattering aftershocks, disintegrating enemies on contact. His martial arts are not just physical strength, but a deadly symphony of Blood Demon Art and immortal pride!
introduction_ph: Sa isang laban ng buhay at kamatayan sa hangganan ng buhay at kamatayan, pinukaw ni Akaza ang natutulog na potensyal sa kanyang dugo. Ang matinding poot na pinagsama sa sinaunang espirituwal na kapangyarihan ay nagpalakas sa kanya na umunlad lampas sa hangganan — bawat suntok ngayon ay may kasamang alon na sumisira sa kaluluwa, nagwawasak sa mga kaaway sa unang tama. Ang kanyang sining ng pakikipaglaban ay hindi lamang pisikal na lakas, kundi isang nakamamatay na simponya ng Blood Demon Art at walang hanggang karangalan!
introduction_ma: Dalam pertarungan hidup dan mati di sempadan antara kehidupan dan kematian, Akaza membangkitkan potensi yang tertidur dalam garis keturunannya. Gelombang kebencian yang kuat digabungkan dengan tenaga roh kuno membolehkannya berevolusi melebihi had — setiap tumbukan kini membawa gegaran yang memusnahkan jiwa, memusnahkan musuh sebaik bersentuhan. Seni mempertahankan dirinya bukan sekadar kekuatan fizikal, tetapi simfoni maut Seni Iblis Darah dan kebanggaan abadi!

name: Tamayo
introduction_th: ในการต่อสู้ชีวิตหรือความตายบนเส้นแบ่งระหว่างโลกแห่งชีวิตและความตาย Akaza ปลุกศักยภาพที่หลับอยู่ในสายเลือดของเขา คลื่นความเกลียดชังที่รุนแรงรวมกับพลังวิญญาณโบราณทำให้เขาพัฒนาเกินขีดจำกัด — แต่ละหมัดตอนนี้สร้างแรงสั่นสะเทือนทำลายจิตวิญญาณ ทำลายศัตรูทันทีที่ถูกโจมตี ศิลปะการต่อสู้ของเขาไม่ใช่แค่พลังร่างกาย แต่เป็นซิมโฟนีแห่งความตายของศิลปะปีศาจเลือดและความภาคภูมิใจอมตะ!
introduction: Beneath a refined exterior lies a soul once devoured by darkness. Tamayo – the mysterious demon doctor – chooses the path of healing in a world soaked in blood. She wields medicine instead of weapons, uses blood instead of a sword, silently opposing Muzan with intelligence and compassion. Every step she takes is proof of gentleness without weakness, and hatred without need for shouting.
introduction_vn: Ẩn sau vẻ ngoài nhã nhặn là một linh hồn từng bị bóng tối nuốt chửng. Tamayo – y sĩ quỷ bí, chọn con đường chữa lành giữa thế giới đầy máu tanh. Nàng dùng y thuật thay cho vũ lực, máu thay cho gươm, lặng lẽ chống lại Muzan bằng trí tuệ và lòng trắc ẩn. Mỗi bước đi là minh chứng cho sự dịu dàng không yếu mềm, và lòng căm hận không cần phải gào thét.
introduction_in: Di balik penampilan yang anggun tersembunyi jiwa yang pernah ditelan kegelapan. Tamayo – dokter iblis misterius – memilih jalan penyembuhan di dunia yang penuh darah. Dia menggunakan ilmu kedokteran menggantikan senjata, darah menggantikan pedang, diam-diam melawan Muzan dengan kecerdasan dan kasih sayang. Setiap langkahnya adalah bukti kelembutan tanpa kelemahan, dan kebencian tanpa perlu berteriak.
introduction_en: Beneath a refined exterior lies a soul once devoured by darkness. Tamayo – the mysterious demon doctor – chooses the path of healing in a world soaked in blood. She wields medicine instead of weapons, uses blood instead of a sword, silently opposing Muzan with intelligence and compassion. Every step she takes is proof of gentleness without weakness, and hatred without need for shouting.
introduction_ph: Sa likod ng maayos na panlabas ay isang kaluluwang minsang nilamon ng kadiliman. Si Tamayo – ang misteryosong doktor ng demonyo – pinipili ang landas ng pagpapagaling sa mundong puno ng dugo. Ginagamit niya ang medisina sa halip na armas, dugo sa halip na espada, tahimik na kumakalaban kay Muzan gamit ang talino at habag. Bawat hakbang niya ay patunay ng banayad na lakas na hindi mahina, at galit na hindi kailangang isigaw.
introduction_ma: Di sebalik penampilan yang anggun terdapat jiwa yang pernah ditelan kegelapan. Tamayo – doktor iblis misteri – memilih jalan penyembuhan dalam dunia yang penuh darah. Dia menggunakan perubatan menggantikan senjata, darah menggantikan pedang, diam-diam menentang Muzan dengan kecerdasan dan belas kasihan. Setiap langkahnya adalah bukti kelembutan tanpa kelemahan, dan kebencian tanpa perlu menjerit.

name: Ulquiorra Cifer
introduction_th: Dracule Mihawk — นักดาบที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดในโลก ครอบครองดาบ Yoru (Black Sword – หนึ่งใน 12 ดาบระดับสูงสุด) และสามารถใช้ทั้ง Observation Haki และ Armament Haki
introduction: Once a wandering Hollow in the darkness of Hueco Mundo, Ulquiorra Cifer evolved into an Arrancar and was chosen by Aizen as the Cuatro Espada – a symbol of emptiness. Beneath his cold exterior and noble demeanor lies a being that no longer believes in heart or emotion. He fights with absolute reason, seeing existence as void. Yet during his confrontation with Ichigo, the first cracks in his emotionless facade began to appear. Death does not frighten him – what confuses him is the notion of a “heart” he has never understood.
introduction_vn: Từng là một Hollow lang thang giữa bóng tối Hueco Mundo, Ulquiorra Cifer tiến hóa thành Arrancar và được Aizen chọn làm Tứ Espada – biểu tượng của hư vô. Sau vẻ ngoài lạnh lùng và dáng vẻ quý tộc là một sinh thể không còn tin vào trái tim hay cảm xúc. Hắn chiến đấu bằng lý trí tuyệt đối, xem sự tồn tại là trống rỗng. Nhưng giữa cuộc đối đầu với Ichigo, những khe nứt đầu tiên trên vỏ bọc vô cảm đã xuất hiện. Cái chết không khiến hắn sợ hãi – điều khiến hắn bối rối là ý niệm về “trái tim” mà hắn chưa từng hiểu.
introduction_in: Dulunya merupakan Hollow yang mengembara di kegelapan Hueco Mundo, Ulquiorra Cifer berevolusi menjadi Arrancar dan dipilih oleh Aizen sebagai Cuatro Espada – simbol kehampaan. Di balik penampilan dingin dan sikap bangsawannya terdapat makhluk yang tidak lagi mempercayai hati atau emosi. Dia bertarung dengan alasan mutlak, memandang keberadaan sebagai kekosongan. Namun saat menghadapi Ichigo, retakan pertama pada wajah tanpa emosi-nya mulai muncul. Kematian tidak menakutinya – yang membingungkannya adalah gagasan tentang “hati” yang tidak pernah ia pahami.
introduction_en: Once a wandering Hollow in the darkness of Hueco Mundo, Ulquiorra Cifer evolved into an Arrancar and was chosen by Aizen as the Cuatro Espada – a symbol of emptiness. Beneath his cold exterior and noble demeanor lies a being that no longer believes in heart or emotion. He fights with absolute reason, seeing existence as void. Yet during his confrontation with Ichigo, the first cracks in his emotionless facade began to appear. Death does not frighten him – what confuses him is the notion of a “heart” he has never understood.
introduction_ph: Dati siyang isang wandering Hollow sa dilim ng Hueco Mundo, si Ulquiorra Cifer ay nag-evolve bilang Arrancar at pinili ni Aizen bilang Cuatro Espada – simbolo ng kawalan. Sa likod ng kanyang malamig na panlabas at maringal na kilos ay isang nilalang na hindi na naniniwala sa puso o damdamin. Nakikipaglaban siya gamit ang ganap na rason, tinitingnan ang pag-iral bilang kawalan. Ngunit sa kanyang pakikipaglaban kay Ichigo, unang mga bitak sa kanyang walang-emosyong panlabas ang nagsimulang lumitaw. Ang kamatayan ay hindi siya natatakot – ang nakalilito sa kanya ay ang konsepto ng “puso” na hindi niya kailanman naunawaan.
introduction_ma: Dahulunya merupakan Hollow yang mengembara dalam kegelapan Hueco Mundo, Ulquiorra Cifer berkembang menjadi Arrancar dan dipilih oleh Aizen sebagai Cuatro Espada – simbol kekosongan. Di sebalik penampilan dingin dan sikap bangsawan terdapat makhluk yang tidak lagi mempercayai hati atau emosi. Dia bertarung dengan akal yang mutlak, melihat kewujudan sebagai kekosongan. Namun semasa berhadapan dengan Ichigo, retakan pertama pada fasad tanpa emosi mula muncul. Kematian tidak menakutkannya – apa yang mengelirukannya ialah konsep “hati” yang tidak pernah difahaminya.

name: Ulquiorra Segunda Etapa
introduction_th: เคยเป็น Hollow ที่เร่ร่อนในความมืดของ Hueco Mundo, Ulquiorra Cifer พัฒนาเป็น Arrancar และถูก Aizen เลือกเป็น Tứ Espada – สัญลักษณ์ของความว่างเปล่า เบื้องหลังรูปลักษณ์เย็นชาและท่าทางสูงส่งคือสิ่งมีชีวิตที่ไม่เชื่อในหัวใจหรืออารมณ์ เขาสู้ด้วยเหตุผลอย่างสมบูรณ์ มองการมีอยู่เป็นความว่างเปล่า แต่ระหว่างการเผชิญหน้ากับ Ichigo รอยแตกแรกบนเปลือกไร้อารมณ์เริ่มปรากฏ ความตายไม่ทำให้เขากลัว สิ่งที่ทำให้เขางุนงงคือแนวคิดของ "หัวใจ" ที่เขาไม่เคยเข้าใจ
introduction: Ulquiorra – Segunda Etapa, the final embodiment of emptiness. His black wings stretch across the night sky, eyes cold and emotionless. His regenerated body is shrouded in darkness, surpassing all Espada. The lance Lanza del Relámpago tears hope apart. He fights not out of hatred, but to prove the void within his heart. When the heart appears, even death becomes beautiful.
introduction_vn: Ulquiorra – Segunda Etapa, hóa thân cuối cùng của hư vô. Đôi cánh đen sải rộng giữa trời đêm, ánh mắt lạnh lẽo không cảm xúc. Cơ thể tái sinh phủ đầy bóng tối, vượt xa mọi Espada. Thanh thương Lanza del Relámpago xé tan hy vọng. Hắn chiến đấu không vì căm thù, chỉ để chứng minh khoảng trống trong tim. Khi trái tim xuất hiện, cái chết cũng trở nên đẹp đẽ.
introduction_in: Ulquiorra – Segunda Etapa, perwujudan terakhir dari kehampaan. Sayap hitamnya membentang di langit malam, mata dingin tanpa emosi. Tubuhnya yang beregenerasi diselimuti kegelapan, melampaui semua Espada. Tombak Lanza del Relámpago merobek harapan. Dia bertarung bukan karena kebencian, tetapi untuk membuktikan kekosongan di dalam hatinya. Ketika hati muncul, bahkan kematian pun menjadi indah.
introduction_en: Ulquiorra – Segunda Etapa, the final embodiment of emptiness. His black wings stretch across the night sky, eyes cold and emotionless. His regenerated body is shrouded in darkness, surpassing all Espada. The lance Lanza del Relámpago tears hope apart. He fights not out of hatred, but to prove the void within his heart. When the heart appears, even death becomes beautiful.
introduction_ph: Ulquiorra – Segunda Etapa, ang huling katawan ng kawalan. Ang kanyang itim na pakpak ay umaabot sa kalangitan ng gabi, mga mata malamig at walang emosyon. Ang kanyang nabagong katawan ay natakpan ng kadiliman, lampas sa lahat ng Espada. Ang sibat na Lanza del Relámpago ay sumisira ng pag-asa. Nakikipaglaban siya hindi dahil sa galit, kundi upang patunayan ang kawalan sa kanyang puso. Kapag lumitaw ang puso, maging ang kamatayan ay nagiging maganda.
introduction_ma: Ulquiorra – Segunda Etapa, perwujudan terakhir kekosongan. Sayap hitamnya terbentang di langit malam, mata sejuk tanpa emosi. Badannya yang diregenerasi diselubungi kegelapan, melebihi semua Espada. Tombak Lanza del Relámpago mengoyak harapan. Dia bertarung bukan kerana kebencian, tetapi untuk membuktikan kekosongan dalam hatinya. Apabila hati muncul, walaupun kematian menjadi indah.

introduction_th: Ulquiorra – Segunda Etapa, การแสดงตัวสุดท้ายของความว่างเปล่า ปีกสีดำของเขาขยายออกกลางท้องฟ้ายามค่ำคืน ดวงตาเย็นชาไร้อารมณ์ ร่างกายที่ฟื้นคืนชีพปกคลุมด้วยความมืด เหนือกว่า Espada ทุกตัว หอก Lanza del Relámpago ฉีกความหวังออก เขาสู้ไม่ใช่เพราะความเกลียดชัง แต่เพื่อพิสูจน์ช่องว่างในหัวใจ เมื่อหัวใจปรากฏ แม้ความตายก็กลายเป็นงดงาม
introduction: Jiren is an extremely powerful warrior from Universe 11 in Dragon Ball Super, a key member of the Pride Troopers. He possesses superior physical and mental strength, capable of overwhelming most opponents without transformation. Jiren is known for his cold, quiet demeanor, always focused on his objectives and believing that absolute power is the key to upholding justice.
introduction_vn: Jiren là một chiến binh cực kỳ mạnh mẽ đến từ Vũ trụ 11 trong Dragon Ball Super, thành viên chủ chốt của đội Pride Troopers. Anh sở hữu sức mạnh thể chất và tinh thần vượt trội, có thể áp đảo hầu hết đối thủ mà không cần biến hình. Jiren nổi tiếng với tính cách lạnh lùng, ít nói, luôn tập trung vào mục tiêu và tin rằng sức mạnh tuyệt đối là chìa khóa bảo vệ công lý.
introduction_in: Jiren adalah seorang pejuang yang sangat kuat dari Alam Semesta 11 dalam Dragon Ball Super, anggota kunci Pride Troopers. Dia memiliki kekuatan fisik dan mental yang luar biasa, mampu mengalahkan sebagian besar lawan tanpa transformasi. Jiren dikenal dengan sifatnya yang dingin, pendiam, selalu fokus pada tujuan, dan percaya bahwa kekuatan mutlak adalah kunci untuk menegakkan keadilan.
introduction_en: Jiren is an extremely powerful warrior from Universe 11 in Dragon Ball Super, a key member of the Pride Troopers. He possesses superior physical and mental strength, capable of overwhelming most opponents without transformation. Jiren is known for his cold, quiet demeanor, always focused on his objectives and believing that absolute power is the key to upholding justice.
introduction_ph: Si Jiren ay isang napakalakas na mandirigma mula sa Universe 11 sa Dragon Ball Super, pangunahing miyembro ng Pride Troopers. Taglay niya ang natatanging lakas pisikal at mental, kaya niyang dominahin ang karamihan ng kalaban nang hindi nagko-transform. Kilala si Jiren sa kanyang malamig at tahimik na ugali, laging nakatuon sa kanyang layunin at naniniwala na ang ganap na kapangyarihan ang susi sa pagpapanatili ng katarungan.
introduction_ma: Jiren ialah seorang pahlawan yang sangat kuat dari Alam Semesta 11 dalam Dragon Ball Super, ahli utama Pride Troopers. name: Jiren the Ultimate Warrior
introduction_th: Jiren เป็นนักรบที่ทรงพลังอย่างมากจากจักรวาลที่ 11 ใน Dragon Ball Super สมาชิกสำคัญของทีม Pride Troopers เขามีพละกำลังทั้งร่างกายและจิตใจที่เหนือชั้น สามารถเอาชนะคู่ต่อสู้ส่วนใหญ่ได้โดยไม่ต้องแปลงร่าง Jiren มีชื่อเสียงด้วยนิสัยเย็นชา เงียบขรึม มุ่งมั่นกับเป้าหมายเสมอ และเชื่อว่าพลังสูงสุดคือกุญแจในการรักษาความยุติธรรม
introduction: In Full Power mode, Jiren unleashes the full potential of his body, causing his muscles to bulge and veins to stand out, showing his strength at its peak. His signature gray skin glows under the red-and-purple aura, radiating a terrifying pressure that shakes the space around him. His cold red eyes blaze like fire, carrying unwavering will and absolute focus on his target. Every movement Jiren makes generates immense pressure, cracking the ground and rattling the air. This is the moment Jiren becomes the embodiment of the “absolute power” he believes in — an unbreakable wall, ready to crush any challenger.
introduction_vn: Ở trạng thái Full Power, Jiren giải phóng toàn bộ tiềm năng cơ thể, khiến cơ bắp phồng to và các đường gân nổi rõ, biểu thị sức mạnh đạt đến cực hạn. Làn da xám đặc trưng càng nổi bật dưới lớp hào quang đỏ rực pha sắc tím bao quanh, tỏa ra sức ép khủng khiếp làm rung chuyển không gian. Đôi mắt đỏ sắc lạnh lóe sáng như thiêu đốt, ánh nhìn chứa đựng ý chí bất khuất và sự tập trung tuyệt đối vào mục tiêu. Mỗi cử động của Jiren đều tạo ra áp lực khổng lồ, khiến đất đá xung quanh nứt vỡ và không khí rung lên bần bật. Đây là khoảnh khắc Jiren trở thành hiện thân của “sức mạnh tuyệt đối” mà anh tin tưởng — một bức tường không thể bị phá vỡ, sẵn sàng nghiền nát mọi kẻ thách thức.
introduction_in: Dalam mode Full Power, Jiren melepaskan seluruh potensi tubuhnya, membuat ototnya membesar dan urat-urat menonjol, menunjukkan kekuatan puncaknya. Kulit abu-abu khasnya bersinar di bawah aura merah-keunguan, memancarkan tekanan mengerikan yang mengguncang ruang di sekitarnya. Matanya yang merah dan dingin menyala seperti api, membawa tekad yang tak tergoyahkan dan fokus mutlak pada target. Setiap gerakan Jiren menghasilkan tekanan besar, membuat tanah retak dan udara bergetar. Inilah momen di mana Jiren menjadi perwujudan “kekuatan mutlak” yang dia yakini — dinding yang tak bisa dihancurkan, siap menghancurkan setiap penantang.
introduction_en: In Full Power mode, Jiren unleashes the full potential of his body, causing his muscles to bulge and veins to stand out, showing his strength at its peak. His signature gray skin glows under the red-and-purple aura, radiating a terrifying pressure that shakes the space around him. His cold red eyes blaze like fire, carrying unwavering will and absolute focus on his target. Every movement Jiren makes generates immense pressure, cracking the ground and rattling the air. This is the moment Jiren becomes the embodiment of the “absolute power” he believes in — an unbreakable wall, ready to crush any challenger.
introduction_ph: Sa Full Power mode, pinakakawala ni Jiren ang buong potensyal ng kanyang katawan, na nagpapalaki ng kanyang mga kalamnan at nagtatampok ng mga ugat, ipinapakita ang kanyang lakas sa sukdulan. Ang kanyang kilalang kulay-abo na balat ay nagliliwanag sa ilalim ng pulang-ugat na aura na may bahid ng lila, nagpapalabas ng nakakatakot na presyon na yumanig sa paligid. Ang kanyang malamig na pulang mga mata ay naglalagablab na parang apoy, nagdadala ng hindi matitinag na kalooban at ganap na pokus sa kanyang target. Bawat galaw ni Jiren ay nagbubunga ng napakalaking presyon, nagpapatilas ng lupa at nagpapakalog ng hangin. Ito ang sandali na si Jiren ay naging katawan ng “ganap na kapangyarihan” na kanyang pinaniniwalaan — isang pader na hindi mababasag, handang durugin ang anumang hamon.
introduction_ma: Dalam mod Full Power, Jiren melepaskan sepenuhnya potensi tubuhnya, menyebabkan otot-ototnya membengkak dan urat menonjol, menandakan kekuatan pada tahap maksimum. Kulit kelabu ikoniknya bersinar di bawah aura merah-purpa, memancarkan tekanan yang dahsyat yang menggoncang ruang di sekeliling. Mata merah dinginnya menyala seperti api, membawa kehendak yang tidak tergoyahkan dan tumpuan mutlak pada sasaran. Setiap pergerakan Jiren menghasilkan tekanan hebat, menyebabkan tanah retak dan udara bergetar. Inilah saat Jiren menjadi perwujudan “kuasa mutlak” yang dia percayai — dinding yang tidak boleh dipecahkan, sedia untuk menghancurkan setiap pencabar.
